summary: Experimental POP that converts line strips or points into camera-facing triangle geometry for thick, distance-dependent colored lines, rounded joins, caps, point circles, and vector-style output similar to the engine used by Line MAT.

key_params.name: camera
key_params.note: Camera used to build camera-facing thick lines

key_params.name: depthinterpolationmodel
key_params.note: Depth interpolation model for width and color falloff

key_params.name: widthfar
key_params.note: Line width far from the camera

key_params.name: widthaffectedbyfov
key_params.note: Scale width behavior with camera FOV or orthographic width

key_params.name: liftdirection
key_params.note: Lift triangles toward the camera or along normals

key_params.name: liftscale
key_params.note: Amount of lift applied in the chosen lift direction

key_params.name: numptsincircle
key_params.note: Number of points used for generated point circles and rounded elements

key_params.name: id
key_params.note: Thread id parameter for Line MAT-style generated geometry

key_params.name: linejointtype
key_params.note: Round, miter, or bevel line joins

key_params.name: linestartcaptype
key_params.note: Start cap style for generated lines

key_params.name: lineendcaptype
key_params.note: End cap style for generated lines

key_params.name: linefarcolor
key_params.note: Line color far from the camera

key_params.name: linefaralpha
key_params.note: Line alpha far from the camera

key_params.name: attribute
key_params.note: Attribute used for vector direction or value

key_params.note: Reference white handling for parameter color conversion

key_concepts: Line Thick POP converts line strips or points into camera-facing triangles for thick lines, caps, joins, point circles, and optional vectors.
Camera, depth interpolation, near/far distances, width, color, and lift controls make the generated geometry distance-dependent.
Line, vector, cap, and color-space pages control display geometry details, so downstream POPs receive triangles rather than abstract line primitives.
common_gotchas: This is an Experimental namespace operator; prefer conservative plans and validate in the target TouchDesigner build.
A valid camera context is part of the geometry calculation, so missing or mismatched cameras produce misleading output.
The operator emits triangles for display, not abstract line primitives; downstream line-processing POPs may no longer apply.
